name: DPC damp-proof course roll
note: FSD Kenya social housing Typology 2 materials & labour schedule, REV.1 July 2024, QS Getso Consultants, Nairobi: item 2.8 DPC to superstructure walling, KES 800 per roll.

name: Flush door, standard (frame priced separately)
note: FSD Kenya social housing Typology 2 materials & labour schedule, REV.1 July 2024, QS Getso Consultants, Nairobi: flush door 800x2050 KES 6,500; supply of door 900x2100 KES 12,285. Door frame 100x50 listed separately at KES 100/ft (about 16 ft per door), not included here.

name: Window, standard, per m2 of opening
note: FSD Kenya social housing Typology 2 materials & labour schedule, REV.1 July 2024, QS Getso Consultants, Nairobi: 900x1800 window KES 8,910 and 600x900 KES 2,970, both KES 5,500 per m2 of opening. 5 mm clear glass listed separately at KES 180/sq ft (about KES 1,940/m2); the high figure includes it.

name: Sanitary set: WC, wash hand basin with taps, shower
note: FSD Kenya social housing Typology 2 materials & labour schedule, REV.1 July 2024, QS Getso Consultants, Nairobi: water closet KES 13,000 + wash hand basin with taps KES 4,000 + shower KES 4,500 (sum of the three listed rates).

name: Electrical point installation (labour)
note: JengaHub contractor rates, updated March 2026: electricians often charge per point, KSh 500–1,000/point. Labour only: cable, switches, sockets and consumer unit are not included.

name: Crane offload at site
note: BeyondForest crane rental guide (Aug 2025, updated 12 Sep 2025): mobile crane KSh 8,000 per service; 25-ton mobile crane about KSh 28,000 per day. Road transport of the container is not included.

name: Hollow concrete block, 6 inch
note: ACL concrete blocks guide (15 Nov 2025): 'KSh 50-80 for standard 6-inch hollow blocks'; 9-inch hollow KSh 70-100. National range; about 10 blocks per m2 of wall.

name: EPS wall panel, per m2 of wall
note: Construction Kenya (29 Jun 2025) quoting NHC: 'a wall using EPS panels for Sh1,800 per square metre'. Shotcrete/plaster to both faces costed separately (cement, sand).

name: EPS slab panel, per m2
note: Construction Kenya (29 Jun 2025) quoting NHC: 'a slab for Sh2,350 per square metre'. Not used in single-storey BoQs.

name: Precast bungalow shell incl. labour, per m2 floor area
note: Money254 (5 Aug 2024): '121 square-metre precast bungalow shell, including labour, costs approximately Ksh1.5 million' (KES 12,400/m2) and the article's own 'roughly Ksh20,000 per square metre'. Interior finishes about Ksh1 million extra. What the shell includes (foundation, roof) is not itemised: QS review.
